description: ~ prompts and the ruminate tool: a background run of the session thinks it over, and its answer enters as the session's own

disableInRuminator.title: Plugins off in the ruminator
disableInRuminator.description: Plugins the background ruminator starts with switched off, comma-separated (name@marketplace): those that would act on their own in it, like a messaging listener. Empty leaves them all as the session has them.
